title: Law must change on aged care algorithm to allow human override, ombudsman says
paragraphs: Use of automation in Australia's aged care system lacks safeguards and has led to unfair outcomes for elderly patients, the Commonwealth Ombudsman has found.
The ombudsman released his findings after an investigation into the Department of Health, Disability and Ageing's classification algorithm.
Of the 10 recommendations made, six were accepted by the government and a further two, including instating a human override, were noted.
